headword: {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}

definitions.explanation: Technology that converts spoken language into text or commands. Used in smartphones, smart speakers, and various digital devices to allow hands-free operation and dictation.

examples.japanese: {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}の{精度|せいど}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: The accuracy of voice recognition has improved.

examples.japanese: このアプリは{音声認識|おんせいにんしき}で{文字|もじ}を{入力|にゅうりょく}できる。
examples.english: This app can input text using voice recognition.

examples.japanese: {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}{技術|ぎじゅつ}のおかげで、{運転中|うんてんちゅう}でもスマートフォンを{操作|そうさ}できるようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to voice recognition technology, it has become possible to operate a smartphone even while driving.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun formed from {音声|おんせい} (voice, audio) + {認識|にんしき} (recognition). Widely used in technology contexts. Often appears as a modifier: {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (voice recognition technology).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (voice recognition technology)
- {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}{機能|きのう} (voice recognition function)
- {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}の{精度|せいど} (voice recognition accuracy)
- {音声認識|おんせいにんしき}で{入力|にゅうりょく}する (to input via voice recognition)
